name: EKODI Service Layer Boundaries
principle: Reusable infrastructure belongs to system services, reusable general-purpose utilities belong to common services, reusable domain expertise belongs to professional services, and actual operating records and decisions belong to the owning workspace or service admin.

classification.system: Required for platform survival, trust, security or execution regardless of business domain.
classification.common: Reusable across unrelated domains without embedding one domain's operating rules.
classification.professional: Reusable domain-specific engine, expertise, adapters or business rules consumed by multiple workspaces or services.
classification.service-owned: Concrete records, settings, relationships and decisions controlled by one operating owner.

common.tenantDataRule: Only explicit tenant-scoped contracts may store tenant data.

professional.tenantDataRule: Engine facts may be central; each owner's operating choices remain owner-scoped.

service-owned.centralAdminExposure: Summary and health only unless explicit delegated authority exists.

rules: Classify by reusable responsibility, not by current screen location.
Professional engines may be centrally operated but must not absorb workspace-owned operating records.
Every workspace kind follows the same ownership and projection rules; no named customer or EKODI-owned service is an architectural exception.
Workspace admins consume system, common and professional capabilities without inheriting platform authority.
Secrets and provider credentials remain server-side even when a workspace controls enablement.
Central Admin shows cross-service health, contracts and capability status; workspace-specific CRUD stays under that workspace admin.
Mixed features are split into system infrastructure, common utility, professional engine and owner-specific projection instead of being assigned to one oversized layer.
Legacy central owner-specific screens may exist only as compatibility surfaces and must not appear as canonical central navigation.
